text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That was a tough race after all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: However... I've shown you the results.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Even so, now that we've missed the Triple 
Crown, we need a title worthy of taking 
its place.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed. You should aim for a race steeped 
in tradition and prestige— the Tenno Sho 
(Spring)."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
3,200 meters is quite a long distance, but 
it's the perfect chance to prove your 
prowess as a stayer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
There may be all kinds of races, but 
winning the Tenno Sho truly adds prestige 
to an Umamusume's name.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Paying respect to the path of hardship and 
effort paved by our predecessors, let us 
claim victory without fail.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I must brace myself further and strive to 
be worthy of the "Emperor."

And so, the next target race was decided: 
the Tenno Sho (Spring).
When we returned to the waiting room...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: President... thank you for your hard work.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Ah, Air Groove. Were you waiting for me?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. I intended to head straight home 
right after saying hello..."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Are you feeling unwell somewhere?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You don't look well. A lack of sleep, or 
perhaps inadequate nutrition seems to be 
the culprit.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I apologize, I've run into a bit of 
trouble with some of my work...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You're doing it? That's rare.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
There were a few different procedures than 
usual for organizing the New Year's Eve 
event, so it took a little...

Upon asking, it turned out the student 
council hosts a New Year's Eve event every 
year, and Air Groove had been put in 
charge of making the preparations for it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Why didn't you report this earlier? I'll 
make the arrangements on my end 
immediately.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I am deeply... sorry...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Please, do not apologize. Hard work is 
admirable, but you have been pushing 
yourself too hard lately.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You are exceptionally capable, but even 
you have your limits during busy periods. 
Feel free to rely on me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: President...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let us move on to student 
council duties.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I just finished the biggest job of the 
year-end right this second. It actually 
worked out better this way.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Which brings me to this, Trainer. I have a 
favor to ask.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Take care of Air Groove. Could you make 
sure she gets some rest?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
While I get ready to head back... let's 
see. Could you pick out a snack for them?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No, there is no need to go to such 
lengths. I will prepare it myself.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Between you, whose judgment is likely 
impaired by fatigue, and the battle-tested 
Trainer, you know whose judgment is 
sounder.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I'll leave it to you, then.

After a light meal, Symboli Rudolf headed 
back to the academy together with Air 
Groove.

Afterward, the New Year's Eve event went 
ahead without a hitch, serving as a 
wonderful source of comfort and cheer for 
the Umamusume who hadn't gone home for the 
holidays.
